main_text.l: damin cœlum subuolantis speciem præbuit sanctissimus Christi martyr,quippe qui ωυγοιντι πρὸς οὐρανον ἡλυθε̇ ἁιφρω. Huiusmodi sunt (pie lector) Vuicleuicæ doctrinæ fructus. Quos mundo prouentus ædit papistica sanctitas ipsi uideant. Si cuiusque drοctrinam suis fructibus metiri uelimus, hunc spectemus, quem cum infinitis aliis Vuicleui ter illa abominanda doctrina pepe rit. Sic enim ab ipso Vualdeno gra-uissimo utique aduersario accepi-mus ab ipso testatum Oldcastello, quemadmodū & supra commemo-ratum est, Haud unquam se aliter intellexisse quanta esset peccati la-bes ac uenenum, nisi ex Vuicleui audita uoce. Fertur nec sine huius consensu conclusiones has in parla-mentum adductas, quas idcirco hoc loco subnectendas curaui.

page.notes: The Greek phrase is printed in a Greek font and is transcribed approximately; the Greek line is doubtful. The word "drοctrinam" may be a misprint for "doctrinam". Catchword "Libel-" is set at the right foot of the text and is also present in the main text, so it is kept as a paragraph. The last line is short and indented, marking a paragraph end.
